newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's HICP rises 1.3 pct in Jan yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's HICP rises 1.3 pct in Jan yr-on-yr.

text.p: Sweden's Harmonised Index for the Consumer Price Index (HICP) rose 1.3 percent over the past 12 months to January, Statistics Sweden said on Friday.
It was the first time Sweden released its HICP which replaces the provisional index for consumer prices.
Statistics Sweden said in the month of January the HICP rose 0.2 percent compared to the previous month.
The HICP is used to compare inflation levels in member countries of the European Union, Iceland and Norway.
Statistics Sweden will release its CPI data for February at 0815 GMT on March 12.
